Name: Generate missing areas (experimental)
Description: Finds walkable ground the nav mesh is missing - rooftops, lift platforms, and other spots the game's own generator skipped - and adds it. If there's no .nav file yet, this builds one from scratch instead.
Warning: Experimental. Adds areas that have not been verified in game; review the result before shipping it.

Name: Start from scratch
Description: Throws away the existing nav mesh and builds a new one, instead of just filling in the missing parts. Only works together with "Generate missing areas".
Warning: Destructive. Deletes every area, ladder and hand placement already in the .nav beside the BSP. Back it up first if you want to keep it.

Name: Skip ladders
Description: Skip building nav ladders. Bots generally can't use them anyway outside Left 4 Dead, so this rarely changes anything.

Name: Skip movement
Description: Don't mark stairs or add step, jump, drop and lift connections.

Name: Skip visibility
Description: Skip working out which areas can see each other. This is the slowest step - skipping it leaves bots less aware of good hiding or ambush spots.

Name: Max view distance
Description: How far apart two areas can be and still count as able to see each other. Lower values compile faster but bots lose some long-range awareness.

Name: Do not compress visibility
Description: Store the full visibility data instead of compressing it. Roughly doubles the file size; mainly useful for debugging.

Name: Thread limit
Description: Limit how many CPU cores NavPal uses. Leave blank to use all of them - useful if you want to keep using your computer for other things during a long compile.
